name: neurospark
description: Interactive Spiking Neural Network (SNN) simulator and biological neurodynamics studio

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((req,res)=>{let p='.'+req.url.split('?')[0];if(p==='./')p='./index.html';let ext=path.extname(p);let m={'.html':'text/html','.js':'text/javascript','.css':'text/css','.json':'application/json','.png':'image/png'};fs.readFile(p,(e,d)=>{if(e){res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not Found')}else{res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m[ext]||'text/plain','Cache-Control':'no-cache'});res.end(d)}})}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('⚡ NeuroSpark running at http://localhost:8080'))"
